item.title: Stripped to the Groove: Derek Frank’s Bass and Drums Take on I Heard It Through the Grapevine
item.description: Derek Frank sits deep in the pocket on Grapevine, pairing great time with a vintage P bass and some of the best gear in the room.

item.title: Inside the Stambaugh Designs Duo Switcho: A Double-Neck 8-String/4-String Bass With Retro Roots
item.description: A deep dive into the Stambaugh Designs Duo Switcho, a bold double-neck 8-string/4-string bass inspired by ’60s Harmony guitars, built with inventive switching and custom details throughout.

item.title: Michael League Explores New Rhythmic Ground on "Elipsis" with Antonio Sánchez and Pedro Martinez
item.description: Snarky Puppy bassist Michael League releases "Elipsis," a six-song trio album with Antonio Sánchez and Pedro Martinez blending deep-rooted traditions, improvisation, and global rhythm.

item.title: A Study in Bass Conversation: Janek Gwizdala and Daniele Camarda Play “Epilogue”
item.description: A pure bass duet. Janek Gwizdala and Daniele Camarda close Seminaro with Epilogue, a relaxed and conversational performance filmed in black and white.

item.title: Dingwall Unveils Jacob Umansky “Sol” Signature Bass at Winter NAMM 2026
item.description: Dingwall debuts the Jacob Umansky “Sol” Signature Bass at Winter NAMM 2026. The multi-scale model features FDV pickups, a Darkglass Tone Capsule, and Umansky-driven design tweaks.

item.title: Sandberg Guitars Unveils Florence Nova Bass for 40th Anniversary at Winter NAMM 2026
item.description: Sandberg Guitars celebrates 40 years with the Florence Nova Bass, a minimalist new model designed with Victor Tugores and unveiled at Winter NAMM 2026.

item.title: From the NAMM Floor: No Treble’s Daily Coverage for Bass Players
item.description: No Treble is heading to NAMM and will be on the floor all week sharing bass gear news, artist sightings, and key updates as they happen.

item.title: Les Claypool Announces “Claypool Gold” Tour Featuring Primus, Frog Brigade, and Claypool Lennon Delirium
item.description: Les Claypool announces the “Claypool Gold” tour, performing nightly with Primus, The Claypool Lennon Delirium, and Fearless Flying Frog Brigade, plus a new song and album tease.

item.title: Watch: Laura Lee’s Bass Drives Khruangbin’s Hypnotic Live KEXP Session
item.description: Khruangbin’s full KEXP session finds Laura Lee on her new Fender signature bass, locking deep grooves in an intimate studio performance.

item.title: Bass Gym: Developing Slap Groove Control With Sextuplets and Hammer-Ons
item.description: Develop stronger slap bass control with a focused Bass Gym workout using sextuplets, shuffle feel, and hammer-ons to create fluid, funky grooves.
